g.text: Frozen validation FPR ≤ 1% thresholds; AE-B uses benign-only calibration
Points: mean ± sample SD (ddof=1), n=5. Test FPR is not constrained to 1%.
Cohorts are separate: conventional controls in the right panels are sliced and recalibrated on matched validation targets.
